notes.title: Last Frontier Playtest Round 2
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b]
We’re excited to announce the launch of the [b]second round of playtesting[/b] for our game [b]Last Frontier[/b]! The playtest is already available for you to join.[/p][h3]What’s new since the last playtest:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Procedural level generation[/b] — every game session now starts on a unique map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New monster[/b] — no more passive enemies. Now it actively hunts you down and reacts to the sounds you make. Be careful: noise may cost you your life.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New items and various improvements[/b] — an expanded set of tools and features to make survival even more engaging.[/p][/*][/list][p]Welcome to the playtest!
We look forward to hearing your feedback and impressions — they are what help us make the game better.[/p]

notes.title: Last Frontier Playtest is now available!
notes.notes:
Welcome, players! 🎮

Great news: Last Frontier is ready for playtesting! We invite you to be a part of this crucial stage in the game's development.

Dive into the gameplay experience on the test map and explore everything the game has to offer. If you encounter a bug or issue, simply press the N key and describe what happened — your feedback will help us make the game even better! 🚀

After testing, please take a moment to fill out a short survey — your opinion is incredibly valuable to us. Together, we can make Last Frontier the best it can be! 💪

Thank you for your support! ❤️

Share your experience! Post videos on YouTube, record short clips, and spread the word about the playtest to your friends.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/Vf45HcUSXG]Discord community[/url] to discuss the game and connect with other players!

Gameplay Guide for Last Frontier: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2809380/discussions/0/595146960680298964/]click here[/url]

notes.title: Playtest Sign-Up is Now Open for Last Frontier!
notes.notes:
[h1]🚀 Playtest Sign-Up is Now Open for Last Frontier! 🕷️🩸[/h1]

[h2]Greetings, trench survivors! 🪖💀[/h2]

We’re excited to announce that we’re opening sign-ups for the Playtest of our upcoming horror game — Last Frontier! This is your chance to step into the dark, twisted world before release, experience terrifying new mechanics, and help shape the future of the game. ⚙️🎮

[h2]Why join the Playtest?[/h2]
🩸 Be among the first to experience the horror.
🛠 Help us improve the game with your feedback.
💡 Join a community of brave souls shaping Last Frontier.

[h2]How to join?[/h2]
✔️ Head over to the game’s page — Last Frontier.
✔️ Click "Request Access" to join the Playtest.
✔️ Wait for your invitation… and prepare to face the nightmares lurking in the trenches. 🕷️⚔️

We’ll be thrilled to have you on board and can’t wait to hear your thoughts and experiences! 🤝

See you in the haunting world of Last Frontier! 🩸
